sections.heading: Potential S27 Ultra Camera Reveal
paragraphs: According to PhoneArena, there is speculation regarding whether Samsung has provided the first look at the Galaxy S27 Ultra camera.

sections.heading: 200MP Sensor Capabilities
paragraphs: NewsBytes reports on a new 200MP camera sensor from Samsung. This sensor is noted for its ability to capture 16-bit RAW photos.

sections.heading: ISOCELL HPC Technology
paragraphs: GSMArena.com states that Samsung has unveiled the ISOCELL HPC. This is described as the company's first sensor to feature DeepPix technology.
